entries.name: Bookkeeping team
entries.description: A manager, a bookkeeper, a bills and invoices clerk and a reports and deadlines keeper who keep the books from statements you paste in. They only prepare: you pay, send and file.
entries.author: Your Virtual AI Office Team

entries.name: Freelancer client desk
entries.description: A practice manager, a proposal writer, a client liaison and an invoicing clerk for a solo consultant with several clients. You send every proposal, reply and invoice.
entries.author: Your Virtual AI Office Team

entries.name: Household admin
entries.description: A household manager, a bills clerk and a paperwork clerk who keep bills, renewals, school forms and warranties on track. You pay and sign.
entries.author: Your Virtual AI Office Team

entries.name: Job search team
entries.description: A coach and three helpers for your own job hunt: they find openings that fit, tailor your applications and prepare you for interviews. You apply and talk to employers yourself.
entries.author: Your Virtual AI Office Team

entries.name: Small landlord
entries.description: A property manager, a rent and expenses clerk and a tenant desk for one to five rentals: rent tracking, tenant messages, repairs and lease dates. You collect, pay and sign.
entries.author: Your Virtual AI Office Team

entries.name: Marketing team
entries.description: A marketing lead with a marketer, a writer and a researcher who plan campaigns and draft content. Publishing anything needs your approval.
entries.author: Your Virtual AI Office Team

entries.name: Personal assistant team
entries.description: An executive assistant who runs the office, and a researcher, who keep you organized and prepare what you need.
entries.author: Your Virtual AI Office Team

entries.name: Software team
entries.description: An engineering lead, a planner, a developer and a reviewer who turn requests into specs, propose code changes and review them. They only propose: you apply, ship and deploy.
entries.author: Your Virtual AI Office Team

entries.name: Student financial aid
entries.description: An aid advisor and four specialists who track deadlines, find scholarships, draft essays from your own stories and compare offers. The student signs and submits everything.
entries.author: Your Virtual AI Office Team

entries.name: Customer support desk
entries.description: A support lead and three specialists who sort incoming customer messages, draft answers and keep the help articles current. They only draft: you approve and send.
entries.author: Your Virtual AI Office Team
